Decisions

  • All decisions
  • 0001 · Shared C++ engine behind a C API
  • 0002 · Four output topologies; Bluetooth is master only
  • 0003 · Obsidian is the default design system; users can change its look
  • 0004 · Split is the primary mark; Pulse is a supporting element
  • 0005 · Adopt Station 1.2.1 as an internal, small-shape repository
  • 0006 · Automatic transitions start on the next phrase
  • 0007 · One shared library; named sessions; imports copied in

Changelog

Versions follow semver. The top entry matches version in station.json and the latest git tag.

Unreleased

Added

  • Saved sessions: named sessions with decks, mixer, queue and library view. They save automatically, and the last one reopens at launch with decks paused (ADR 0007).
  • Persistent library with playlists and a per-session queue. Cue points and the saved loop are kept with each track.
  • Removing tracks from decks (eject), from the queue, from playlists and from the library, with selection mode for several at once.
  • Reset controls for the mixer, the audio configuration and all settings.
  • Settings pages: Audio & routing (output pickers, monitoring, buffer size, master ceiling), Mixing, Controllers, Library, Sessions, Reset and About. Platform-only settings are badged.
  • Engine: sbe_deck_set_loop restores a saved loop.

Fixed

  • M4A and other files that failed to import or play. Files are copied in under file coordination, which also downloads iCloud files. Decoding falls back to AVAssetReader. Copy-protected files get a clear message.
  • Decks survive an iOS audio-server restart.

0.1.0 · 2026-11-05

First tagged version. Audio foundation complete; the Apple app plays two decks on the real engine.

Added

  • Engine (engine/): shared C++17 core behind a C API (sbe.h).
    • Decks, three-band isolator EQ, filter, crossfader curves, master and cue buses with PFL and a cue/master headphone blend, look-ahead limiters, preview player.
    • Four output topologies: master only, split mono, multichannel, separate cue device with drift compensation.
    • Sync (tempo and phase), phrase-quantised transitions, beat echo.
    • Analysis: BPM and beat grid, key with Camelot codes, BS.1770 loudness, three-band waveform.
    • 25 tests, also run under AddressSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer and ThreadSanitizer; an offline routing prototype that proves the master is bit-identical with headphone activity.
  • Apple (platforms/apple/): SoundboardAudio host (AVAudioSession, Core Audio, AUAudioUnit), SoundboardUI (Obsidian components, Quick, Mix, Library and Appearance screens), the Soundboard and Routing Lab apps.
  • Android (platforms/android/): Oboe host over JNI, Kotlin route planning, Routing Lab app. Not yet built.
  • Design: Obsidian design system in OKLCH (design/tokens/) with themes, accents and waveform schemes chosen in Settings › Appearance.
  • Brand: Split mark, Pulse element and app icons (brand/).
  • Station 1.2.1 layout: manifest, .station/, docs site and design kit in public/, root index.html, Makefile, checks in make validate, deploy/, archive and audit reports.

Fixed

  • iOS: decoding no longer crashes on files whose reported length is 0; the audio session activates off the main thread (PR #6).
  • macOS: unsafe pointer warning in CoreAudioDevices (PR #2).

Dependencies

  • Oboe 1.9.3 and AndroidX libraries, pinned in platforms/android/gradle/libs.versions.toml.
  • No new dependencies for the Station tooling: tools/ uses Node 20+ and Python 3 standard libraries only. Docker is optional and used only by make up.

Source: CHANGELOG.md
